abstract.doc: Abstract rows are the M1 trace harness's step encoding (holon.mreplay.encode_step) of these facts' actions; the M1 refinement corpus and the I15 witnesses are written in them.

doc: Binding of the I20 refinement of the extracted rollup document (holon/replay_fragments.py): the generic step harness on the real Rollup at the pinned commit, deployed as the M1 trace harness deploys it.

init.doc: holonDeploy's [F, W, D, t0, r0]: the M1 facts' initial state, as holon.mreplay.run_forge passes it

project.doc: the scratch project mirrors the checkout's contracts/ Foundry tree, so a project path p is the document unit contracts/p

window.doc: The token encodings of the abstract rows, as the M1 trace harness translates them (replay/M1/solidity/HolonTraceReplay.t.sol: a principal is the caller who2addr(who), a time is EPOCH + t, a blob token is the blob hash blobEnc(v)), and the abstraction's stand-in for a version-2 blob hash (its abstractions: keccak256 over the blob hashes is agg(), the definition blob_hash at version 2); holon fragments learns each one from the steps' abstract inputs and their concrete calls (holon.replay_fragments.learn_decode) and writes it as the decode tables of the window corpus (results/M2/refinement/extracted/window_states.json, holon.window).
